dialogues.speaker: Tecoma
dialogues.text: Okay! Let's keep it flowing — one more set! Muscles don't grow by sitting around!

dialogues.speaker: Tecoma
dialogues.text: That's it! Focus on your form! I want every rep to look like that! Muscles will reward you, muscles will appreciate you, and muscles will carry this tribe to greatness!

dialogues.speaker: Tecoma
dialogues.text: Wipe that look off your face! Why are you pausing? Will pausing grow your muscles!?

dialogues.speaker: Tecoma
dialogues.text: Listen up, fresh meat, you need to learn from Coach Iansan, every second of every day. Faster! Stronger! Musclier!
